subject: Entity Linking
source_sentence: Entity Linking encompasses a set of similar tasks, which include Named Entity Disambiguation (NED), that is the task of linking entity mentions in a text to a knowledge base , and Wikification, i.e., the automatic annotation of text by linking its relevant fragments of text to the appropriate Wikipedia articles.
title: Entity Linking meets Word Sense Disambiguation: a Uniﬁed Approach
